chunks: Now see the end of their machinations: We destroyed them and their entire people.
ai.seo_question: What was the final outcome of Pharaoh's plotting against Moses according to Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *'Adab al-Dhulm* (the etiquette of tyranny), illustrating how Pharaoh's internal plotting (*makr*) inevitably led to the total annihilation of his dynasty and people. It serves as a paradigmatic example of divine retribution where the architects of deception are consumed by their own schemes, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the inevitability of truth prevailing over arrogant falsehood.
